event_description: Apple Q4 FY2022 earnings: iPhone revenue missed estimates amid weakening consumer demand and FX headwinds; management guided for revenue deceleration in holiday quarter
Apple Q2 FY2023 earnings beat: EPS of $1.52 beat estimates of $1.43; services revenue hit record $20.9 billion; management signaled return to growth
Strong Q4 iPhone demand signals from supply chain partners in Asia; TSMC and Foxconn report robust Apple orders
Microsoft Q1 FY2023 earnings miss: Azure cloud growth decelerated to 35% from 46% prior quarter; PC market weakness weighed on Windows revenue; guided for further cloud slowdown
Microsoft announced layoffs of 10,000 employees, about 5% of workforce; cited macroeconomic conditions and slowing growth
Microsoft Q3 FY2023 earnings beat: Azure accelerated to 27% growth driven by AI workloads; Copilot commercial preview announced; raised full-year guidance
NVIDIA Q2 FY2023 earnings: datacenter revenue hit record $3.8 billion; announced $10 billion buyback; data center demand far outpaced gaming weakness
NVIDIA Q3 FY2023 earnings: gaming revenue collapsed 51% YoY; warned of continued inventory digestion; gross margin compressed significantly
NVIDIA Q1 FY2024 earnings blowout: revenue guidance of $11 billion for Q2 doubled analyst estimates; CEO cited insatiable AI demand for H100 GPUs; initiated $25 billion buyback
October 2022 CPI came in at 7.7%, well below the 8.0% estimate; market rallied sharply on hopes of Fed pivot and peak inflation narrative
August 2022 CPI surprised to the upside at 8.3% vs 8.1% expected; core CPI accelerated, crushing Fed pivot hopes and triggering broad market selloff
Silicon Valley Bank collapsed after a run on deposits; FDIC took over; triggered fears of broader regional banking contagion and financial stability concerns
Apple announced Vision Pro mixed-reality headset at WWDC 2023; developer excitement high; announced 15-inch MacBook Air and major iOS 17 features
Microsoft announced integration of ChatGPT-powered AI into Bing search and Edge browser; framed as major competitive challenge to Google in search market
NVIDIA Q2 FY2024 earnings: revenue tripled YoY to $13.5 billion; datacenter revenue up 171%; raised Q3 guidance to $16 billion; AI demand described as exceptional and broad-based
